response.original_title: A Pagan Valentine's Day: Lupercalia and the Dark History of Love
response.overview: In Rome, wolf-priests ran naked through February, whipping women with goat-hide to buy them children. In Scotland, a woman who knew a king's wedding-night words was strangled at the stake. Every red rose on the fourteenth covers the same wet stone.
response.title: A Pagan Valentine's Day: Lupercalia and the Dark History of Love
